package clickhouse

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/column"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/driver"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type sessionSummaryDriverConn struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	row driver.Row
}

func (conn sessionSummaryDriverConn) QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) driver.Row {
	return conn.row
}

type sessionSummaryDriverRow struct {
	driver.Row
	activeSeconds int64
}

func (row sessionSummaryDriverRow) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 7, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	*dest[0].(*time.Time) = now
	*dest[1].(*time.Time) = now.Add(time.Duration(row.activeSeconds) * time.Second)
	// Exercise the pinned native driver's real conversion, rather than accepting
	// an unsigned destination that ClickHouse's toInt64 aggregate cannot scan.
	for _, index := range []int{2, 3} {
		var value column.Int64
		if err := value.AppendRow(row.activeSeconds); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := value.ScanRow(dest[index], 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	for index := 4; index < len(dest); index++ {
		var value column.UInt64
		count := uint64(0)
		if index == 10 {
			count = 1 // countIf(event_type = 'test_passed')
		}
		if err := value.AppendRow(count); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := value.ScanRow(dest[index], 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func TestLearningSessionSummaryScansNativeInt64ActiveTime(t *testing.T) {
	for _, activeSeconds := range []int64{0, 60, 120} {
		repository := NewLearningSessionSummaryRepository(sessionSummaryDriverConn{
			row: sessionSummaryDriverRow{activeSeconds: activeSeconds},
		})
		studentID, sessionID := uuid.New(), uuid.New()
		summary, err := repository.GetLearningSessionSummary(context.Background(), studentID, sessionID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("native Int64 active time %d: %v", activeSeconds, err)
		}
		if summary.StudentID != studentID || summary.AnalyticsSessionID != sessionID || summary.ActiveLearningSeconds != int(activeSeconds) || summary.WallClockSeconds != int(activeSeconds) || summary.PassedTestCount != 1 || summary.FailureCount != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected native summary: %+v", summary)
		}
	}
}
